locations.title: Camp locations
locations.intro: The unified place inventory, used across the app to tag issues, tasks, assets, dorms, and retreats.

guide.intro: Spreadsheet format — one row per location. Column headers are matched loosely (case-insensitive):
guide.name: — the location's name, e.g. “Birch Cabin”.
guide.category: — e.g. Housing, Waterfront, Dining. Created automatically if it's new.
guide.parent: — the exact name of another location to nest under (list parents above their children).
guide.dorm: — yes / true / x to mark a sleeping quarters.

locations.empty: No locations yet. Add areas below or import a spreadsheet.
locations.addPlaceholder: e.g. Waterfront, Dining Hall, Bunk Row A

pools.title: Pools & waterfront
pools.intro: Aquatic locations tracked in Pool Management

rate.title: Your rate
rate.body: Used for a new booking and for any quote where you have not set a different price.
rate.depositHelp: Filled in on every new agreement. Blank asks for no deposit.

defaults.title: Agreement defaults
defaults.chaseHelp: Counted from the day the deposit invoice went out. Blank means never.

inquiry.title: Public inquiry link
inquiry.confirmOff: Turn the inquiry link off? Anyone using the old link will see "not recognised".
inquiry.help: Put it on your website or in a reply. Inquiries arrive in the pipeline as new leads.
inquiry.offHelp: Off by default. Nothing is public until you make one.

payments.errorReach: Stripe could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
payments.title: Card payments
payments.subtitle: Let groups pay a deposit or a balance from their portal.
payments.yoursBody: This is Stripe Connect. You get your own Stripe account, and payments settle straight into your bank on Stripe's normal schedule. CampCommand never holds your money, never sees a card number, and holds no key for your account — we create the checkout link and Stripe does the rest. Stripe's processing fee comes out of each payment; we do not add one.
payments.unknown: The payment status could not be read just now. Nothing has changed on your account.
payments.off: Not connected. Groups can still pay you the way they do now — the portal shows your own payment instructions on every invoice until this is switched on.
payments.adminOnly: Only a camp administrator can set this up.
payments.pendingBody: Your Stripe account exists but cannot take payments yet. Stripe usually wants a bank account, or ID for whoever owns the business. Pick up where you left off — nothing you have already entered is lost.
payments.liveBody: Invoices in the guest portal now carry a Pay button. Payments and payouts are visible in your own Stripe dashboard.

files.followUp: Our team will load it and follow up.
files.title: Send us your setup files
files.intro: Getting your camp set up? Send your existing spreadsheets and lists here and our team will load them for you. This is the only place to send data. Please don't email it.
files.dropBlurb: Spreadsheet, PDF, or document, whatever format you already have it in.
files.privacy: Files land in your camp's own private storage, no other camp can reach them, and every upload is recorded in your activity log. Uploads are kept permanently as a record of what you sent us.
files.sentIntro: A permanent record of every file handed off during setup.

agreement.title: Your retreat agreement
agreement.showTokens: What can be filled in automatically
agreement.intro: Write it once. Anywhere a detail changes by group, put a marker like {{marker}} and each booking gets its own filled in. You review every value before it sends.
agreement.clickHint: Click one to add it at the end, or type it anywhere yourself.
agreement.placeholder: Paste your facility use agreement here, then mark the parts that change by group.
agreement.unknown: Nothing fills {{tokens}} — it will appear in the agreement exactly like that. Remove it, or pick one from the list above.

descriptions.title: Saved descriptions
descriptions.intro: Write a description once, then point as many rooms at it as it fits. Editing it here changes every room using it.
descriptions.placeholder: Eight bunks, screened windows, shared bathhouse a short walk away. No heat.
descriptions.empty: None yet. Rooms can still be described one at a time — these are for descriptions you would otherwise paste into a dozen rooms.
descriptions.delete: Delete this description. Rooms using it keep their own.

poolModal.namePlaceholder: e.g. Main Pool, Lower Lake, Waterfront
poolModal.typeHelp: Swimming pools and "other" types include the chemical log. Waterfront locations use equipment + inspection tracking only.
